title: Command output & automation scripts (research note §6)
note: install-all.sh and scan-pipeline.sh are safe Lyra wrappers. The research-note scripts that scrape registries, invent unpublished packages, start Cuckoo live, or POST Slack webhooks are wont-do.

scripts.detail: Wraps install-toolchain + deps:verify + mcp:audit. Closest installs only.
Existing one-shot closest-install path for MCP, pip, git clones, extensions.
Polls GET /v1/anomaly fixtures. No OpenStates scrape, FBI matcher, or Slack webhook.
